label: carry
note: Anchor is the previous clip's last frame. Highest continuity demand; QC scores this link hardest. Read off the run structure, never chosen.

label: reframe
note: Anchor is the previous clip's last frame. Composition shifts; scene facts hold.

label: cut
note: Anchor set explicitly. QC must not penalise the break — a hard cut scored as a continuity failure is a false negative that GATE spends a reseed on.

label: light direction
text: key direction must not move across the seam
note: Pin list entry. Naming the pin turns a 0-10 QC score into a diagnosis.

label: time of day
text: ambient level and colour temperature must not move

label: wardrobe / colour
text: subject's clothing and its colour must not change
note: Pin list entry. The most common visible drift in a carry.

label: lens
text: apparent focal length and depth of field must hold

label: subject scale
text: subject's size in frame must be continuous with the move
note: Pin list entry. Breaks first on OTS and other relational framings.

label: background geometry
text: the built world behind the subject must not rearrange
